pairs: ne in furore tuo arguas me,
do not rebuke me in your fury,
neque in ira tua corripias me.
nor chastise me in your anger.
for my bones have become disturbed,
Et anima mea turbata est valde;
and my soul has been very troubled.
salvum me fac propter misericordiam tuam.
Save me because of your mercy.
Quoniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui;
For there is no one in death who would be mindful of you.
in inferno autem quis confitebitur tibi?
And who will confess to you in Hell?
I have labored in my groaning.
lavabo per singulas noctes lectum meum:
I will wash my bed and drench my blanket.
Turbatus est a furore oculus meus;
My eye has been troubled by rage.
I have grown old among all my enemies.
Discedite a me omnes qui operamini iniquitatem,
Scatter before me, all you who work iniquity,
quoniam exaudivit Dominus vocem fletus mei.
for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
The Lord has heard my supplication.
The Lord has accepted my prayer.
Erubescant, et conturbentur vehementer, omnes inimici mei;
Let all my enemies be ashamed and together be greatly troubled.
May they be converted and become ashamed very quickly.
